also_valid_note: Real label rules that don't matter for the South Dakota demo. Extracting them is not an error (precision), and missing them is not a miss (recall).

also_valid.quote: In the state of New York, a 25 ft vegetated, non-cropped buffer strip untraversed by drainage tiles must be maintained between a treated field and a coastal salt marsh or stream that drains into a coastal salt marsh, for both aerial or ground application.
For Western irrigated agriculture, a maintained vegetative filter strip of at least 10 feet wide is required.
Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 15 miles per hour at the application site.
Do not apply when wind speed favors drift beyond the area intended for treatment or non-uniform distribution of treated water.

rules.quote: Do not apply within 25 feet of aquatic habitats (such as, but not limited to, lakes, reservoirs, rivers, streams, marshes, ponds, estuaries, and commercial fish ponds).

rules.note: Non-ULV aerial: the one that applies to a spray drone.
rules.quote: Do not apply within 150 feet of aquatic habitats (such as, but not limited to, lakes, reservoirs, rivers, streams, marshes, ponds, estuaries, and commercial fish ponds).

rules.note: ULV aerial only. The rule schema cannot say 'ULV only', so buffers.plan would apply it to every aerial run.
rules.quote: Do not apply within 450 feet of aquatic habitats (such as, but not limited to, lakes, reservoirs, rivers, streams, marshes, ponds, estuaries, and commercial fish ponds).

rules.note: Vegetative filter strip to down-gradient aquatic habitat (15 ft or less under listed conditions).
rules.quote: Only apply products containing Lambda-cyhalothrin onto fields where a maintained vegetative filter strip of at least 25 feet exists between the field edge and where a down gradient aquatic habitat exists.
Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 15 mph at the application site.

rules.note: Stated for ground boom, boomless ground and airblast.
rules.quote: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 15 mph at the application site.
